$comment: CRA's administrative policy on gifts, awards and long-service awards to employees, by tax year (docs/31 §6.1). The Step 17 loader copies each verified year into ref.gift_award_rule; talent.reward computes each reward's bucket and taxable amount from it, and payroll confirms the taxable part. Values include taxes. Arm's-length employees only; anything else goes to payroll for review.

years.cite: Canada Revenue Agency, Gifts, awards, and long-service awards (page modified 2026-07-27)

gift_card_non_cash_conditions: Preloaded, and usable only at a single retailer or a group of retailers named on the card
Its terms say the loaded amount cannot be converted into cash
The employer logs the employee's name, the date, the reason, the card type, the amount and the retailers
always_taxable: Near-cash: securities, precious metals or jewels, gift cards that fail the conditions, prepaid network cards, digital currency
Rewards tied to job performance (meeting targets, finishing a project); the $500 limit does not apply
long_service_rules: Recognizes 5 or more years of service with the employer
At least 5 years since the employer's last long-service award
A separate $500; its unused part cannot be used for other gifts and awards
